name: NexLevel
description: Create Together. Build Beyond. Real-time collaborative level editing.

relay-server.name: Relay server
relay-server.description: Address of the NexLevel relay (host or host:port). With a relay, rooms work from any network, including mobile data. Everyone in a room must use the same relay. Leave empty to play without one.

show-ping.name: Show ping in the editor
show-ping.description: Shows your ping to the room in the editor while you are in a room.

show-frames.name: Show other players' view
show-frames.description: Draws a coloured frame with each player's name where they are working in the editor.
